title: Treat obesity-associated obstructive sleep apnoea with an approved medicine

concept.text: Reduce clinically significant sleep-disordered breathing pharmacologically in adults with obesity. Tirzepatide achieved an OSA indication following trials both with and without background positive-airway-pressure treatment. Proposed completion test: FDA approval for moderate-to-severe OSA in adults with obesity, supported by randomized trials showing clinically meaningful superiority in apnoea–hypopnoea index at 52 weeks. Test set by: FDA; the two pivotal trials enrolled 469 adults and used change in AHI as the primary efficacy measure. Reported achieved: FDA approved Zepbound for this OSA indication on 20 December 2024. Overlaps: END-05. Sources given: [FDA OSA approval announcement](https://www.fda.gov/news-events/press-announcements/fda-approves-first-medication-obstructive-sleep-apnea) ; [Sponsor's indication-specific approval announcement](https://lilly.gcs-web.com/news-releases/news-release-details/fda-approves-zepboundr-tirzepatide-first-and-only-prescription).
